windows-apps.name: Windows apps
windows-apps.description: Runs each Windows app in a managed Bottles container.

gaming.name: Gaming
gaming.description: Steam, Proton management, GameMode, controller rules, Vulkan tools, and performance overlays.

appimages.name: Portable apps
appimages.description: Integrates AppImages into the application launcher.

macos-apps.name: macOS Apps (experimental)
macos-apps.description: Builds pinned GPL-3.0 Darling with experimental Metal-over-Vulkan. Needs 25 GiB temporary disk space; compatibility is per app.

local-ai.name: Local AI
local-ai.description: A local-first chat, writing, OCR, and image-description application. Model downloads are separate.

osaii-web-apps.name: OSAII web apps
osaii-web-apps.description: Optional browser shortcuts for OSAII Platform, OSS Studio, and Masque. No local account or files are shared.

backup-plus.name: Advanced backups
backup-plus.description: Borg-based backups for external drives, NAS locations, and encrypted repositories.

developer.name: Developer mode
developer.description: Git, Python tooling, rootless containers, SDK helpers, and build essentials.

virtualization.name: Virtual machines
virtualization.description: GNOME Boxes and advanced libvirt management with UEFI firmware.

native-packages.name: Advanced package manager
native-packages.description: A graphical native Debian package manager for power users.

snap.name: Snap support
snap.description: Installs the optional Snap runtime. It stays absent and disabled by default.
